description: Looks up an Agent Registry entity and returns its canonical Exchange Record.

parameters.description: Optional. The maximum number of records to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified or set to 0, at most 100 records will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: The AI Application Resource Name from the caller header (`AppId: X`). Essential for multi-application URL disambiguation. Format: "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/aiApplications/{ai_application}"
parameters.name: uriResolution.aiApplication

parameters.description: Ingress resolution: Resolve an inbound request targeting a specific workload. Format Examples: * Vertex Agent: "aiplatform.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/agents/{agent}" * Reasoning Engine: "aiplatform.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/reasoningEngines/{engine}" * Cloud Run Service: "run.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/services/{service}"
parameters.name: targetCanonicalResourceUri

parameters.description: Required. The target wire endpoint URI or hostname intercepted by the Gateway. Matching uses Longest Prefix Match (LPM) semantics.
parameters.name: uriResolution.interfaceUri

parameters.description: Required. The parent region/location in which to look up. This represents the project boundaries of the intercepting gateway, which may differ from the target workload's hosting project in multi-project architectures (e.g., Shared VPC or Hub-and-Spoke configurations). Format: "projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}"
parameters.name: parent

parameters.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous `LookupAgentRegistry` call.
parameters.name: pageToken

parameters.description: Optional. The source workload calling the endpoint. Format Examples: * Vertex Agent: "aiplatform.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/agents/{agent}" * Reasoning Engine: "aiplatform.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/reasoningEngines/{engine}" * Cloud Run Service: "run.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/services/{service}" When specified, the service looks up the source workload in the Agent Registry, requires it to be an AGENT entity, and returns its minimal resource record in `source_registry_exchange_record`.
parameters.name: uriResolution.sourceCanonicalResourceUri

description: Annotations describing the characteristics and behavior of a tool or operation.
name: Annotations

destructiveHint.description: If true, the tool may perform destructive updates to its environment. If false, the tool performs only additive updates. NOTE: This property is meaningful only when `read_only_hint == false` Default: true

idempotentHint.description: If true, calling the tool repeatedly with the same arguments will have no additional effect on its environment. NOTE: This property is meaningful only when `read_only_hint == false` Default: false

openWorldHint.description: If true, this tool may interact with an "open world" of external entities. If false, the tool's domain of interaction is closed. For example, the world of a web search tool is open, whereas that of a memory tool is not. Default: true

readOnlyHint.description: If true, the tool does not modify its environment. Default: false

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

authProvider.description: The auth provider resource name. Format: "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/authProviders/{auth_provider}"

scopes.description: The list of OAuth2 scopes of the AuthProvider.

description: A structured, self-documenting catalog of metadata payloads.
name: DataExtension

customExtension.description: Schemaless JSON-like structure for user-defined or vendor-specific custom attributes. Preferred over `google.protobuf.Any` to eliminate secondary byte unmarshalling and enable direct CEL policy evaluation.

endpointRoutingInfo.description: Network routing topology for the endpoint.

mcpServerMetadata.description: Tool metadata exposed by an MCP server.

updateTime.description: Timestamp when this extension payload was last refreshed.

description: Network routing topology for reaching the endpoint.
name: EndpointRoutingInfo

privateEndpoint.description: Whether the endpoint is restricted to private VPC networks (e.g., VPC Service Controls, PSC, Internal Load Balancers) as opposed to being exposed over the public internet.

pscServiceAttachmentUri.description: The resource name of the Private Service Connect (PSC) service attachment. Example: "projects/{project}/regions/{region}/serviceAttachments/{service_attachment}"

description: GCP Resource Manager metadata required for CEL policy evaluation.
name: GcpResourceMetadata

folderNumber.description: The direct parent GCP folder number. Will be 0 if the project lives directly under an organization without a folder.

nextPageToken.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results.

registryExchangeRecords.description: The resolved canonical Registry Exchange Records.

sourceRegistryExchangeRecord.description: The resolved source Registry Exchange Record when a source URI is specified in the request. Only set on the first response page.

description: Holds tool definitions exposed by an MCP server workload.
name: McpServerMetadata

tools.description: Tools provided by the MCP Server.

description: Represents the canonical exchange record for any Agent Registry workload (Agent, MCP Server, or Endpoint), whether standalone in the Management Project or registered under an AI Application.
name: RegistryExchangeRecord

aiApplication.description: The parent AI Application URI owning this record.

canonicalResourceUri.description: The GCP resource URI of the underlying AI workload (agent, MCP server, or endpoint) (e.g., "//run.googleapis.com/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/services/{service}").

interfaceUri.description: Target wire endpoint URI or hostname registered in Agent Registry. Matching uses Longest Prefix Match (LPM) semantics.

registryResource.description: The Agent Registry Resource Name. Format when registered under an AI Application: * "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/aiApplications/{ai_application}/agents/{agent}" * "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/aiApplications/{ai_application}/mcpServers/{mcp_server}" Format when standalone in Management Project: * "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/agents/{agent}" * "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/mcpServers/{mcp_server}" * "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/endpoints/{endpoint}"

description: Represents a single tool provided by an MCP Server.
name: Tool

_meta.description: Protocol-level tool metadata conforming to MCP _meta specification.

description.description: Description of what the tool does.
